title: Camera and Photographic Equipment Repairers
description: Repair and adjust cameras and photographic equipment, including commercial video and motion picture camera equipment.

tasks.text: Adjust cameras, photographic mechanisms, or equipment such as range and view finders, shutters, light meters, or lens systems, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

emerging.task: Adjust or repair cameras, photographic mechanisms, or equipment such as range and view finders, shutters, light meters, or lens systems, using hand tools.
emerging.original_task: Adjust cameras, photographic mechanisms, or equipment such as range and view finders, shutters, light meters, or lens systems, using hand tools.

tasks.text: Disassemble equipment to gain access to defect, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: Test equipment performance, focus of lens system, diaphragm alignment, lens mounts, or film transport, using precision gauges.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Clean and lubricate cameras and polish camera lenses, using cleaning materials and work aids.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

tasks.text: Calibrate and verify accuracy of light meters, shutter diaphragm operation, or lens carriers, using timing instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical calibration to specifications

tasks.text: Examine cameras, equipment, processed film, or laboratory reports to diagnose malfunction, using work aids and specifications.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Locating wear and damage requires physical inspection

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.

tasks.text: Read and interpret engineering drawings, diagrams, instructions, or specifications to determine needed repairs, fabrication method, and operation sequence.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Technical reading for maintenance well handled

dwas.name: Read technical information needed to perform maintenance or repairs.
Interpret blueprints, specifications, or diagrams to inform installation, development or operation activities.

tasks.text: Measure parts to verify specified dimensions or settings, such as camera shutter speed or light meter reading accuracy, using measuring instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical distance measurement in field

dwas.name: Measure distances or dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Fabricate or modify defective electronic, electrical, or mechanical components, using bench lathe, milling machine, shaper, grinder, or precision hand tools, according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

tasks.text: Install electrical assemblies and wiring in aircraft camera housings and memory cards or film in cameras, following blueprints and using hand tools and soldering equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical installation is hands-on licensed trade work

dwas.name: Install electrical components, equipment, or systems.

tasks.text: Assemble aircraft cameras, still or motion picture cameras, photographic equipment, or frames, using diagrams, blueprints, bench machines, hand tools, or power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mechanical assembly needs hands and tools

dwas.name: Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.

tasks.text: Record test data and document fabrication techniques on reports.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Write test result reports from data

tasks.text: Lay out reference points and dimensions on parts or metal stock to be machined, using precision measuring instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying out work physically per specifications

dwas.name: Lay out work according to specifications.

tasks.text: Recommend design changes or upgrades of microfilming, film-developing, or photographic equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Advice good; hands-on equipment context needs human

dwas.name: Advise others on issues related to repairs, installation, or equipment design.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others
